en.hook: Kafka Connect Sink Backpressure Isolation prevents consumer lag spikes from crashing downstream database writers.
en.body:
Kafka Connect Sink Backpressure Isolation prevents consumer lag spikes from crashing downstream database writers. Restore streaming SLOs and cut memory waste.

Operational proof is in the GitHub repository referenced in this post.
